categories_thin: Roofing, siding, windows, restoration, pools, security installers: still no business of these types appears to be based in Jamesburg borough. A BBB Jamesburg roofing category search returned only Monroe Township firms (Longview Contracting, Scotchwood Construction, Bentley Remodeling) plus Biondo Contracting, which advertises Jamesburg as a service area from elsewhere - all outside this zone's town.

Tree care: only RKD Oldham Tree Service (BBB profile, no address captured) plus landscapers who also do tree work (A Cut Above, Sanchez). No dedicated Jamesburg tree-service company with an address was found.

Gyms / fitness: no conventional gym in the borough; Snap Fitness at 198 Buckelew Ave is a franchise brand and is reported permanently closed, so it is excluded. Only yoga, martial arts and personal-training studios are listed.
Marketing/design and staffing agencies: no Jamesburg-based agency found. Searches returned only agencies in Freehold, East Brunswick and other towns that list Jamesburg as a service area.
Photography: one home-based studio (Katy Ann Photography) and directory-only records (J Albert Photography, 24 Half Acre Rd per Manta) - no storefront studio found.
Driving schools: A Plus, Windsor-Brunswick, All Brunswick and Edison all advertise Jamesburg as a service area but none is based in the borough, so none is listed.
Dance/music schools: only the preschool/music academy entry; Stage Door Studio was dropped in this revision (see data_gaps).
Flooring: one shop-at-home dealer (Carpet On Wheels, 12 Holly Rd). No flooring showroom in the borough was found.
Optometry and specialist medicine remain concentrated in the 241/315/333 Forsgate Dr professional buildings.
caveats: Town-vs-ZIP ambiguity: Jamesburg's 08831 ZIP also covers much of Monroe Township, so businesses that Maps and directories label 'Jamesburg' may sit in Monroe (Rossmoor Dr, Centre Dr, Davidson's Mill Rd, Schoolhouse Rd, Englishtown Rd, Rhode Hall Rd, Spotswood-Englishtown Rd addresses). Entries whose street may cross the borough line are flagged in notes; confirm municipality before outreach.

Removed in this revision as outside the borough after checking: M. David DeMarco Funeral Home (205 Rhode Hall Rd is Monroe Township per its directions page) and Monroe French Cleaners (399 Spotswood-Englishtown Rd, Monroe). Both belong in the Monroe zone, not here.
Removed in this revision as excluded brand/franchise: FYZICAL Therapy & Balance Center (franchised therapy brand) and Bin There Dump That Middlesex County (national dumpster-rental franchise).

Hearing aids: the two earlier entries (Audibel / Jamesburg Hearing Specialists at 333 Forsgate Dr, and Penta Hearing Care at 241 Forsgate Dr) referred to one practice. The Audibel Jamesburg domain now redirects to the Penta Hearing Care site, and the federal NPI record at 241 Forsgate Dr Suite 112 is registered to 'Northland Hearing Centers, Inc.', a national hearing-clinic network, so the practice has been dropped as a branded network outlet rather than listed as an independent. It can be re-added if the local ownership turns out to be independent.

Dubin Orthodontics was dropped: the practice's own site lists Monroe Township and Highland Park offices only, and 29 E Railroad Ave is also Archer Law Office's address, so the Jamesburg record looks stale.

Mozarts & Einsteins and Team ELM (childcare/tutoring) are retained under the group D 'childcare and preschools' heading even though a verifier read the exclusion rule as covering schools. Flagged for a scope decision rather than removed unilaterally.
Address conflicts still open: Hulse Plumbing vs Hulse Family Kitchen & Bath (same address), Chad's Auto Repair vs Old Forge Services Center (same address) - possibly renames or moves.

Home-based operators (Bob Hoegler Plumbing, Mayer Plumbing, Warhaftig CPA, All-Wayz, Maximus, Katy Ann Photography) list residential-style or no addresses; only published business phone/address data was recorded, per the business-contact-only rule.

Excluded by rule and not listed: restaurants/cafes/bakeries/delis/pizzerias, groceries, liquor and convenience stores, gas outlets, pharmacies (including the two independents Medscripts and Point of Care Pharmacy that NJTGO lists), banks, chain self-storage (Extra Space/Life Storage), chain urgent care, Primerica, Snap Fitness, places of worship, public schools and the borough offices.
data_gaps: Stage Door Studio (300 Buckelew Ave) and Axles Sneakers (71 E Railroad Ave) were dropped rather than carried forward: both rested on a single aging directory or one-review map record with no website or recent activity, and phones could not be verified from a second source within this read-only research.

Law Offices of John W. Callinan: legal directories still list a Jamesburg office (9 Davison Ave, (732) 521-5177), but the firm's own site now advertises only Sea Girt and Middletown offices, so no active Jamesburg office could be confirmed and no entry was added. Worth a phone check.

YellowPages, BBB, SuperPages, Angi, Manta, AllPages, WhereOrg, Cylex, Justia, Findlaw, Martindale, LocalityBiz and Nextdoor all returned HTTP 403 / bot blocks on direct fetch; those pages were only usable through search-result snippets or the Yahoo Local mirror, which limits verification depth for several directory-only entries.
Google Maps full result lists require sign-in (limited view), so map-derived coverage remains partial; queries were varied by category and zoom.
OpenStreetMap/Overpass API was unreachable in the original pass and was not retried at length; OSM business data is not reflected.

Central NJ Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory (cnjrchamber.org) is JavaScript-rendered and its member list could not be retrieved; the borough website returned no server-rendered licensed-business list.

OpenNPI's Jamesburg listing exposed additional NPI-registered providers at 241 Forsgate Dr (e.g. a physiatry practice in Suite 107, a psychologist practice in Suite 107, a health-service psychologist in Suite 107) that appear in no business directory; they were left out because NPI registration alone does not show the business is trading now.

Phone numbers still not captured for several small industrial/contractor listings (Savona Printing, Sweet Sign Systems, Molintex, Nu Lab, Lab-Tech, GWS Environmental, Firstline Locksmith, Thompson Bark, RKD Oldham) and for Katy Ann Photography.
